rederived_oracles.method: Independent closed form e_eps(x)=2[J1(x)-eps*J1(eps*x)]/x (Sec. 3.2) via scipy.special.jv, D=14m, f=100MHz, eps in {0.1,0.15,0.3}, 5 directions, plus the e(0)=1-eps^2 boresight check; compared against BeamSystem.evaluate_jones (black box, no radiosim.core.beam.aperture import).

L->infinity identity B_sc=(1-e^-mu)|e_det|^2 (Sec. 3.4.1): independent e_det via the fresh 96x384 polar quadrature and independent mu=(4*pi*rms/lambda)^2, compared against BeamSystem.evaluate_ruze_power_diagnostic at correlation_length_m=1e9, rms=0.02m, mode (2,0,0.02).

Independent O(Q^2) pairwise double-sum evaluation of Sec. 3.4's displayed double integral (K_sc(delta)=exp(-mu)*exp(mu*exp(-|delta|^2/L^2))) over a 220x220 uniform Cartesian raster of the unit disk -- a different discretization from any polar Gauss-Legendre x trapezoid raster used in the repository's test suite, and no test-module import -- compared against BeamSystem.evaluate_ruze_power_diagnostic at L=2m, rms=0.02m, mode (2,0,0.02), 3 directions.

Independent closed forms 2J1(x)/x (uniform) and p*2J1(x)/x+(1-p)*8J2(x)/x^2 (12 dB parabolic taper, Sec. 3.1) via scipy.special.jv, compared against BeamSystem.evaluate_jones for circular_aperture uniform/parabolic tapers.

Independent 96-radial x 384-angular polar quadrature (fresh Gauss-Legendre x trapezoid code, no radiosim.core.beam.aperture import) of Sec. 3.1's normalized aperture integral with a (2,0)+(3,1) Zernike surface phase, compared against BeamSystem.evaluate_jones; plus an independent sign-reversal conjugation check (h(-c)=-h(c) => phase(-c)=conj(phase(c))).

accepted_limitations: A1's independent ruze_pair_oracle uses a coarser fixed accuracy bound (2e-4) than production's converged quadrature tolerance because it is evaluated on an independent 220x220 uniform Cartesian raster rather than a boundary-fitted adaptive quadrature.

The extended-width complex256/float128 analytic-invariant rows in the evidence artifact were not independently re-executed because no required Stage-1 oracle depends on extended precision; A1 instead authenticated those two rows' recorded digests for internal consistency and reproduced every float64 diagnostic field of the uniform_pupil_defocus_oracle case exactly on a native arm64 environment distinct from the evidence's x86_64-under-Rosetta environment.
